forbidden: special-case table keyed by frozen instance hash
retroactive calculus extension after seeing results

exact_relation.boundary: one bit y_e for every e in E
exact_relation.violation: viol_v(Y)=ell(v) XOR XOR_{e incident to v} y_e
exact_relation.witness: binary vertex code W of width log2(|V|), with |V| restricted to powers of two
exact_relation.relation: F_G(W,Y) holds iff the decoded vertex v=W satisfies viol_v(Y)=1
exact_relation.domain: D_G(Y)=TRUE for all Y by odd-charge parity
exact_relation.domain_proof_obligation: pi_D must symbolically certify XOR_v viol_v(Y)=XOR_v ell(v)=1 because every edge variable occurs exactly twice
exact_relation.witness_proof_obligation: pi_f must certify that the decoded witness vertex is violated using only locally checked affine violation predicates and complementary GUARDED_ITE composition

finite_series.graph_selection: one deterministic seeded simple 3-regular graph per n; exact edge lists are frozen before constructor implementation
finite_series.charge_selection: deterministic seeded charge vector adjusted once to odd Hamming parity before freeze
finite_series.relabeling: opaque deterministic vertex and edge ids after source freeze
finite_series.source_failure_policy: If a frozen graph is not simple, 3-regular, connected, or fails the preregistered finite spectral-stress gate, return SOURCE_FAMILY_INVALID; do not resample after seeing constructor behavior.

finite_spectral_stress_gate.purpose: finite-instance qualification only; not an asymptotic expander theorem
finite_spectral_stress_gate.metric: second largest eigenvalue lambda2 of adjacency divided by degree
finite_spectral_stress_gate.usage: source qualification only; never available to constructor or verifier as a witness shortcut

required_algorithmic_behavior: derive each local viol_v only as AFFINE_XOR from incident edge bits and charge
construct a shared complementary-guard search DAG that selects some violated vertex
emit one proof root for each witness bit with hash-consed sharing

checks: graph and charge match frozen source authority
each AFFINE_XOR violation guard has exactly the frozen incident-edge support and charge constant
each GUARDED_ITE uses an exact guard/complement split and already checked children
witness-bit roots decode to the selected guard branch at every proof node
odd-charge domain proof cancels every edge exactly twice and leaves constant 1
all output roots share one accounted proof DAG

verdict_rules.PASS_SCOPED_HOSTILE_SYNTHESIS: Every frozen finite instance receives an independently accepted exact DOMAIN+WITNESS+PROOF certificate within the frozen resources.
verdict_rules.FAIL_CALCULUS_EXPRESSIVITY: A compact admissible candidate is separately demonstrated but cannot be certified by the frozen V1.1 rule forms.
verdict_rules.FAIL_SYNTHESIS_ACCESS: After blind candidate freeze, a compact certificate accepted by the same verifier is shown to exist, but the blind constructor did not synthesize it.
verdict_rules.FAIL_PROOF_DAG_BLOWUP: The frozen constructor's observed DAG exceeds a preregistered resource/size envelope. This is an observed constructor outcome, not a lower bound on all possible proof DAGs.
verdict_rules.FAIL_HIDDEN_GENERIC_VALIDATION: Audit finds SAT/coNP validity, truth-table, reference, or equivalent hidden machinery.
verdict_rules.FAIL_DOMAIN_DROPPED: The exact total domain proof is omitted, replaced by assumption, or not independently checked.
verdict_rules.UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT: Only the frozen resource cap prevents classification.
verdict_rules.SOURCE_FAMILY_INVALID: The source graph/charge family violates its preregistered structural qualification before synthesis.

execution_gate: SOURCE FREEZE -> INDEPENDENT SOURCE CHECK -> CONSTRUCTOR+VERIFIER IMPLEMENTATION -> IMPLEMENTATION REVIEW -> ONE BLIND SERIES RUN -> FREEZE -> OPTIONAL POSTFREEZE RECONCILIATION
